summary.headline: Mars as Significator
summary.text: Chapter 45 discusses Mars as significator, including oppositions and fourth aspects of malefics, planetary reception and projection of lights, and concord between the ascendant and its lord. It gives omens for disease, bloodshed, pestilence, destruction of trees and animals, crop damage, conflict, robbery, and injury according to Mars’s sign, angularity, direction, and aspects.
